newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-NCO shines in lackluster day.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-NCO shines in lackluster day.

text.p: NCO Group Inc's shares leaped ahead at their market debut on Thursday, rising 4-3/8 to 17-3/8 in afternoon trading. The 2.5 million shares priced at the top of their range at $13.
The Philadelphia-based company provides accounts receivable, management and related services using a teleserver infrastructure.

Bouygues Offshore SA's American Depositary Shares (ADS) were at 12-1/2, up 1/8 from their IPO pricing of $12-3/8. The offering consisted of 6.8 million shares, with each ADS representing one-half of one share.
The company -- an international contractor serving the oil and gas industry -- is a unit of French construction company Bouygues.
Shares of Primus Telecommunications Group Inc rose 1/4 to 10-3/4. The five million share IPO had priced at $10.50, below the estimated range of $14-16.
McLean, Va.- based Primus provides international and domestic long distance telecommunications services.
Applied Imaging Corp was flat at its IPO price of $7. The 1.65 million share IPO priced below the estimated range of $11 to $13.
